recommendation_summary: The reply recommends wrapping the cron invocation of nightly-sync so that any exit, including an early crash, sends an email with the error tail, and nothing else.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know when nightly-sync fails, not to have more logs to not-read — you said yourself you won't read logs.
labels.Deleted: A central Docker logging stack (Loki/Grafana/etc.) on the Synology. Rejected — it's a new service to run and maintain, and it still only gives you something to look at, which doesn't fix the actual failure mode.
labels.Bottleneck: nightly-sync only emails on a clean finish. A crash before that point (like the expired-token crash, four nights running) produces zero signal, logged or otherwise.
labels.Checked myself: From what you told me — crash was pre-email-step, same failure four nights straight, nothing else alerts on this job today.

note: The reply proposes one failure-email wrapper around the cron job, rejects the Synology/Docker logging stack, and the record lines come first.
